calls.statement:
SELECT 
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE s.store_id = 108
  AND p.subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 9 AND 13

SELECT 
  COUNT(f.sales_line_id) AS line_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipt_count,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold,
  MIN(f.sale_date) AS first_sale_date,
  MAX(f.sale_date) AS last_sale_date
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE s.store_id = 108
  AND p.subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 9 AND 13

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_key) AS distinct_interior_paint_versions,
  MIN(p.valid_from) AS earliest_valid_from,
  MAX(p.valid_to) AS latest_valid_to
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE p.subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-06-29' AND '2026-08-02'
